title: Sebastian and the Veil Again
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Elodie Pemberton, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
